$comment: Neutral guardrail-hook SSOT for this repo — the hooks half of Argo's cross-CLI setup (skills are skills-lock.json's half). One entry per behavior; `packages/argo-skills/bin/hooks-sync.mjs` projects them into each harness named in `agents` below: claude-code -> .claude/settings.json, codex -> .codex/hooks.json. Never hand-edit those generated blocks — edit here and run `bun run hooks:sync`. Commands are harness-neutral: bare `graphify` (on PATH) and `$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/*` (no $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR). The commands invoke this repo's scripts/ via git-toplevel; scaffold.mjs can copy this file AND those scripts into a consumer before projecting, but only opt-in (`--hooks`) since the guard imposes Argo's worktree discipline. See AGENTS.md "Cross-CLI guardrail hooks".

hooks.$comment: Agent changes land through a PR, never a push to the default branch. GitHub cannot enforce this: an agent pushes with the owner's credentials and the owner keeps `enforce_admins: false` for their own hotfixes, so server-side the human and the agent are one identity. Fails CLOSED — an unnamed destination is denied rather than guessed at.

Write only — Edit cannot create a file, so an edit is never a placement decision. Denies a NEW file loose at a module root, which root-files-check.mjs would fail the build on later, once imports already point at it (ADR-0021).
